alert.title: Action required
alert.paragraph1: Apple now requires your iOS app to be linked to your own Apple Developer account (not bsport's). If you do not complete this process before the end of the month, your access to the Back Office will be blocked.
alert.paragraph2: Follow the step-by-step instructions in our <0>playbook</0>.
alert.paragraph3: If you need help, contact our support team at <0>support@bsport.io</0>.

alert.title: Apple Agreement Update
alert.paragraph1: There is an updated Developer Program License Agreement available on your Apple Developer account. We will not be able to update your <0>iOS app</0> until the agreement is accepted.
alert.paragraph2: It takes 1 minute! Here's how to resolve
alert.paragraph3: 1. The <0>account owner</0> must sign in to the Apple Developer account at <1>https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/business</1>.
alert.paragraph4: 2. You'll see a banner prompting you to review the updated <0>Apple Developer Program License agreement.</0>
